AiSummaryResponse.description: The AI analyst slot. The producer is behind the AI gateway and arrives later; the UI renders every state.
AiSummaryResponse.title: AiSummaryResponse

etag.description: Version of this alert's analyst state. Send it back as expected_etag

top_sources.description: The most active source entities. None means not computed: show 'unmeasured'

AlertPatch.description: Analyst state. Written to the S3 overlay, never to the Delta table.

reason.description: Why. Required when closing as noise or resolved; recorded with the change

AlertPatch.title: AlertPatch

source_version.description: Delta version the groups were read at

CaseNote.description: An analyst or agent note. Agent notes carry provenance and never change case or alert state.

model.description: Model id; set only for agent notes

CaseNote.title: CaseNote

expected_etag.description: Required: every case edit is conditional

CatalogResponse.description: Generated from the dictionary, so a new source gets filters and columns without UI code.
CatalogResponse.title: CatalogResponse

dropped.description: Matches beyond the caps, reported not hidden

graph_id.description: This entity's node id in the graph; None when it has no node

action.description: ALLOW, BLOCK, COUNT ... as the source recorded it

approximate.description: True when counts come from a rollup or sketch, not a scan

notes.description: e.g. 'counted over the first 100,000 rows read'

window.description: Edges considered; the server default (7 days) applies when omitted

quarantine_older_count.description: Records older than the window; None when unknown

quarantine_window_hours.description: quarantine_count and reasons cover this many recent hours

stale.description: None when freshness is not evaluated: see stale_reason

stale_reason.description: Why stale is None: no SIEM_SOURCE_EXPECTATIONS entry, or an expectation the rollups cannot evaluate

IndicatorMatch.description:
An intel indicator that matched. ``value`` is the matched IP, domain, URL, hash or address read from the indicator's
pattern; every other field is None when the intel node does not record it (never inferred).

indicator_id.description: The intel node id: an identifier, not the matched value

source.description: The feed the indicator was loaded from

type.description: None when the indicator could not be read, so its type is not known

IndicatorMatch.title: IndicatorMatch

ids.description: matched_indicators entries of alert groups: intel node ids or plain values

matches.description: One per requested id, in order

notes.description: How the numbers were computed (rollup, bounded raw scan, sample)

audit.description: None when the audit source has no data at all (unmeasured, not zero)

ioc_alerts.description: Alert groups of tier ioc that overlap the window: alerts that matched an indicator

telemetry.description: None until a telemetry index exists

threat.description: Indicators LOADED (current intel objects, not windowed). NOT the number of matches

QuarantineGroup.description: Records that share a reason. Counts cover the records read, so they are a lower bound when the response is truncated.

hint.description: Plain-language reading of the reason, from fixed rules

sample_key.description: Raw key of the newest record in the group

QuarantineGroup.title: QuarantineGroup

older.description: True returns only records OLDER than the window instead of those inside it

reason.description: Only records with exactly this reason (a QuarantineGroup.reason)

window_hours.description: How far back 'recent' reaches, by the record's quarantine time. Server default: 36

older_count.description: Records older than the window; None when not counted (unknown, not zero)

QuerySpec.description:
One view of the data. It renders as Python, curl, GraphQL, a DRS manifest or a notebook, so it is the
single description of 'what the analyst is looking at'. Validated against the dictionary server-side.
QuerySpec.title: QuerySpec

source_version.description: Delta version read; None when it could not be determined cheaply

total.description: None when counting would scan; the grid says 'at least'

layout.description: Perspective viewer config for the grid/chart

measured.description: False when no embedding exists, so 'no hits' is not 'nothing similar'

distinct_src_ips.description: None when not exactly measurable (merged rollups, no source column)

TriageStrip.description: Anything not yet computed is None and must render as 'unmeasured', never as zero.

waiting.description: None when the count could not be completed (candidate cap hit)

TriageStrip.title: TriageStrip

measured.description: False renders as 'unmeasured', never as zero or empty

WhyEvidence.description:
What the group's own events show. Paths, actions, sources and countries come from the SAMPLED events
(``events_sampled`` of ``events_total``); ``allowed`` and ``blocked`` are the group's exact totals.

bytes_recorded.description: False when no sampled event carries a response size

status_recorded.description: False when no sampled event carries a response status

WhyEvidence.title: WhyEvidence

measured.description: False renders as 'unmeasured', never as zero or empty

False renders as 'unmeasured', never as zero or empty

verdict.description: Plain-language summary from fixed rules, not a model; states what was not measured

measured.description: False renders as 'unmeasured', never as zero or empty

pack.description: Third-party pack id; None for first-party rules

measured.description: False renders as 'unmeasured', never as zero or empty
